content.thinking:
Excellent. Now let me improve the random generator to produce more interesting coverage scenarios (r between 0 and 1 and r=1) so the brute-force cross-check exercises the coverage logic thoroughly.

Key: with small F (1-3) and small targets (1-3), and enough windows/tokens, r=1 is often achievable. Let me create generator variants:
- variant A: generous (r=1 usually)
- variant B: tight (fractional r)
- variant C: degenerate (r=0)

Let me tweak gen.py to have a "profile" parameter. Also important edge cases:
- 0 windows
- 0 groups
- group ceiling 0 with attached flows
- capacity 0 slots
- B=1, I=0 (no tokens at all)
- expires < all slot times (no eligible slots)
- draw=65535 with threshold 65535 (rejected)
- single slot
- windows with ready > last slot time
- flows with ceiling == target
- deep group chains (32 groups in a chain)
- group with no attached flows

Let me write a dedicated edge-case test file with hand-crafted cases, run them, and verify.

Also I should test invalid inputs thoroughly.

Let me first update the generator for tighter/looser profiles and run a large brute-force campaign (small instances) to catch optimization bugs.
